column3: (Anti-clickjacking header: GitHub Pages cannot set response headers, and frame-ancestors is not allowed in a <meta> CSP. The app has no account actions to clickjack; Google sign-in runs in its own popup.)
(X-Content-Type-Options: response header that GitHub Pages controls; the CI server is Python http.server.)
(Suspicious comments: reviewed. They are plain code comments in the open-source page and contain no secrets.)
(Server version header: from the Python http.server used only in CI, not the live site.)
(CSP header not set: GitHub Pages cannot set headers. The page has a strict CSP in a <meta> tag, enforced by npm run check and tests/security.spec.mjs.)
(Storable and cacheable content: a public static app with no personal data in responses. Caching is intended for offline use.)
(CSP directive with no fallback: frame-ancestors cannot be set in a <meta> CSP. Everything else is defined.)
(Permissions-Policy: response header that GitHub Pages cannot set. The app only uses Bluetooth, USB and the mic after a user tap, through browser prompts.)
(Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy: response header that GitHub Pages cannot set. The app uses no cross-origin isolation features.)
